annotations.text:
Pandai — full flow.

The panda has four states, each its own animation: idle (bobs, blinks, ears twitch, bamboo sways), thinking (head tilt + orbiting dot), rolling (tumbles along while the answer streams), and reading (monocle, eyes tracking down the page).

Colors are lifted straight from globals.css so these match the real app.

The thinking steps here are drawn as REAL states — each one should only appear when that work is actually happening. "Reading your photo" shows only on a real image, never as decoration on a plain text question.
